definition: Catherine Helen O'Neil (born 1972) is an American mathematician, data scientist, and author. 'Weapons of Math Destruction'.
details: She is the author of the New York Times best-seller Weapons of Math Destruction, and opinion columns in Bloomberg View. O'Neil was active in the Occupy movement.

explainer.lead: Cathy O'Neil is an American mathematician. Her work spans mathematics, algebraic geometry and data science.
explainer.knownFor: Notable works include Weapons of Math Destruction.

contributions.name: She is the founder of O'Neil Risk Consulting & Algorithmic Auditing (ORCAA), an algorithmic auditing company and is on the board of the nonprofit ORCAA Collaborative Expert Assistance Network (OCEAN).

timeline.what: O'Neil attended UC Berkeley as an undergraduate, received a Ph.D. in mathematics from Harvard University in 1999, and afterward held positions in the mathematics departments of MIT and Barnard College.
She left academia in 2007, and worked for four years in the finance industry.
Her first book, Doing Data Science, was written with Rachel Schutt and published in 2013.

affiliations: Columbia University Graduate School of Journalism
